entries.text: Well, it looks like this is your room.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_01

entries.text: Most BB students live in the dorms, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_02

entries.text: So, what do you think? How’s it compare to\nthe dorm rooms back at your school?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_03

entries.text: So blue!
entries.label: sdc02_0090_select_01

entries.text: So new!
entries.label: sdc02_0090_select_02

entries.text: About the same!
entries.label: sdc02_0090_select_03

entries.text:
Well, we’re at BLUEberry Academy... ’Course
it’s blue!\c
You can come have a look at my room later, too,
if you want.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_04

entries.text: Heh, you bet it’s new! State of the art, in fact!\nYou can come have a look at my room later, too,\r\nif you want.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_05

entries.text: Whaaat? Psh, that’s no fun... Well, you can come\nhave a look at my room later, too, if you want.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_06

entries.text: Oh, but I got distracted. There’s something I\nneed to tell you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_07

entries.text: It’s about Drayton and...well, Kiki.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_08

entries.text: About Drayton?
entries.label: sdc02_0090_select_04

entries.text: About Kieran?
entries.label: sdc02_0090_select_05

entries.text: And there’s one more thing I need to tell you\nabout![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_31

entries.text: Ugh, Drayton... Don’t trust that knucklehead![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_09

entries.text: He might seem like a slacker, but don’t let him\nfool you! He’s up to something![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_10

entries.text: He’s a real annoying super jerk![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_11

entries.text: He barely even goes to class! He’s had to repeat\nthe same year three times![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_12

entries.text: Point is, don’t let your guard down around him...\never![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_13

entries.text: Kiki is... Well, you saw how he is. He’s scaring\nme nowadays.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_14

entries.text: Ever since we got back from Kitakami, it’s like\nhe’s become a totally different person.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_15

entries.text: He’s been battling and training every day... He’s\neven cutting back on sleep.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_16

entries.text: He’s...he’s definitely gotten stronger.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_17

entries.text: Drayton used to be the strongest student here,\nbut Kiki beat him.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_18

entries.text: Now Kiki’s the president of the League Club\nAND the BB League Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_19

entries.text: I guess he must be pretty busy... He barely talks\nto me anymore.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_20

entries.text: Oh well! He’s probably just going through a\nrebellious phase.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_21

entries.text: Kieran’s changed...but you? You’ve stayed the\nsame.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_22

entries.text: If Kieran’s down to just one friend these days, I’m\nglad it’s you. Keep sticking with him, would you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_23

entries.text: Thank you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_24

entries.text: Can’t you read the room? You were supposed to\nsay yes![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_25

entries.text: You’re going on your date—I mean, you’re\ngonna go hang out with Drayton later, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_26

entries.text: I’d go with, but if I don’t finish up this report\ntoday, I’m really gonna be in trouble...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_27

entries.text: I’d love for you to join the League Club...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_28

entries.text: But if Drayton gives you any trouble, don’t be\nafraid to give him a good Sucker Punch![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_29

entries.text: If Drayton says anything stupid, just hit him with\na Sucker Punch![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0090_sister_30
